EN: Let me tell you what I've seen.
PTBR: Deixa eu te contar o que vi.

EN: With a single bite, I give death and life.
PTBR: Com uma única mordida, dou a morte e a vida.

EN: Vampires are the only true, immortal gods of this realm!
PTBR: Vampiros são os únicos deuses verdadeiros e imortais deste reino!

EN: I will destroy you in the name of the true gods!

EN: I am the beacon of light.
Can't take a joke? Take that then!

EN: I won't hesitate to use my best jokes. You better run!

EN: You will find the dwarven resilience unbearable.

EN: I am the protector of nature.

EN: Only a few have experienced the pain I will inflict upon you.

EN: I am the beacon of light.
I am the hope of mankind.
I am the word of gods.
I am the shield that protects men from evil.

EN: I will pin you down to the ground.

I've seen some tracks, they were massive.
I'm worried about the elves, they've been too quiet lately.

EN: What I would give for a solid bed.

EN: If the wraiths will come, we'll be ready.

EN: Byddaf yn dod a'ch brifo i ben.

EN: Bydd fy mhwerau ia yn eich rhwystro.

EN: Byddaf yn dangos cynddaredd natur i chi.

EN: You've never seen a satyr before?

EN: I'll bite you in the ass!

EN: Please, I don't want to die.

EN: We were so happy before you came along!

EN: Every dwarf knows how to fight.
Day, night, makes no difference in the tunnels.

EN: How do you like it here?
I dunno whot you been told, but our boyz ar mighty bold.

EN: I'm da gobbo dat gets shit done.

EN: Tou think you so clever, e?

EN: We is gonna teach you a lesson.

EN: You look like a tough git.
Ohh, I'm not so 'appy to see you.

EN: I'll protect these people with my life.

EN: You're an invader to our lands.

EN: I have the upper hand over you.

PTBR: Sua falha resultará em sua morte.

EN: You don't look like a warrior.

EN: Our clan will banish you from these lands.

EN: Even if what you say is true, we can't allow you to destroy us.
PTBR: Mesmo que o que você diga seja verdade, não podemos permitir que você nos destrua.

EN: Survival is at the core of every living being. We will persevere. Gods prepared us for you.
PTBR: A sobrevivência está no cerne de todo ser vivo. Persistiremos. Os deuses nos prepararam para você.

EN: Why do you steal them from us?

EN: Steal? Puny mortal, you can't steal by taking what is yours.
PTBR: Roubar? Mortal insignificante, não se rouba ao tomar o que é seu.

EN: All the existence comes from my soul.
PTBR: Toda a existência vem da minha alma.

EN: That cannot be. Our gods created this world and all life in it.
PTBR: Isso não pode ser. Nossos deuses criaram este mundo e toda a vida nele.

EN: They did indeed. They imprisoned me long ago. They stole my soul, piece by piece to create... all of this.
PTBR: Fizeram, sim. Me prenderam há muito tempo. Roubaram minha alma, pedaço por pedaço, para criar... tudo isso.

EN: Enough half-beast, it's time for you to cease your existence.
PTBR: Chega, meio-besta. É hora de você cessar sua existência.

EN: I'm da biggest, so I'm da boss!'
PTBR: Eu ser o maior, então eu ser o chefe!

EN: You stand before Bluzg the King.
PTBR: Você está diante de Bluzg, o Rei.
Mim num é pior que humie.

EN: Me bites and stabs and then...
PTBR: Mim morde e espeta e depois...

EN: [color=150,150,150,255]*broken teeth show up as he smiles proudly after hitting you*[/color]
PTBR: [color=150,150,150,255]*dentes quebrados aparecem quando ele sorri com orgulho depois de te acertar*[/color]

EN: Yus go, and never come back!
PTBR: Você vai, e nunca mais volta!

EN: Me and me fellas will feast on yus remains.

Eu pego ele! Eu pego ele

EN: Oh, you can see my soul?

EN: Oh, I'm gonna ride you like a fuckin' horse.

EN: I'm gonna fuck you up so bad, your momma won't recognize ya.

EN: Oh, you fuckin' prick, now you're gonna get it.

EN: Kane is comin'. Ooh, Kane is comin'.

EN: I hear cries on the horizon.

PTBR: Minhas lâminas têm fome de sangue.

EN: Let me show you the forbidden elven technique, Dance of Macabre.

EN: Witness the beauty of my dance.

EN: I have looked at the world through the blind eyes of dreams.
PTBR: Olhei o mundo através dos olhos cegos dos sonhos.

EN: I've seen the scarlet stream on the skies.

EN: I have followed the visions to find you.

EN: You will help me wrench the truth from the winds of fate.

EN: Spirits of the forest guide my hand.

EN: Gods, let my aim strike true.
PTBR: Deuses, que minha mira acerte em cheio.

EN: [color=150,150,150,255]*you hear a voice in your head*[/color]

EN: You're just a common thug, nothing more.

PTBR: Se desejas morrer, então oponha-te a mim.

EN: And many timesss I have risssen
I grow tired of this game.
